svg.aria-label: Scoring against each run's best-fit line clears 11 of the 12 failing runs
svg.title: Scoring against each run's best-fit line clears 11 of the 12 failing runs
svg.desc: Two dot-strip panels, one row per run. The left panel shows raw deviations with 35 notes outside the tolerance band; the right shows residuals after removing each run's best-fit line, with only 1 outside.
svg.text: Scoring against each run's best-fit line clears 11 of the 12 failing runs
Per-note deviation against the tolerance window, before and after removing the run's own offset and tempo. Same scale in both panels, in ms.
